content: Apply the user-authorized destructive SC0009 replacement under D0029. Keep repository tool acquisition Nix-first, but after a confirmed Nix provision/materialization gap automatically install an exact pacman-resolvable package through a root-owned package-name-only helper and non-interactive sudo. Establish a second root-owned helper for enumerated MetaFlux driver-debug actions, including current module lifecycle, kernel-log/kmemleak inspection, and the named live cdev qualification executable under the exact repository root. Persist only least-privilege host authorization, never the supplied password or any credential in repository files, arguments, environment, output, logs, or session records. Create the canonical escalation decision, migrate all current startup/toolchain surfaces, verify both helpers and current host authorization without installing an unnecessary package, then return M0110/W0112 to a newly scaffolded successor.
